intro.text: Someone who hears a faint thrumming in the dark and reads the breaks in it to find islands, making it possible to steer across the emberdark.
Someone who can feel the Grand Knell's Current and whatever blocks it, charting courses through the emberdark more accurately than any other known magic or technology.

description.text: Birds bonded to a Navigator hear the thrumming too.
Obstacles strengthen the pulse rather than weakening it, the reverse of what a wayfinder sees in waves.
A Navigator must hold Investiture, usually by eating luminist; the more they hold, the keener their sense, and it lasts until the Investiture runs out.

A Seeker can only find the Grand Knell's direction, but a Navigator senses obstructions to the Current from far away and understands what causes them, both in the unsea and in the air. Striking the chest makes a tuning-fork note that works like sonar.
Only trappers who have survived the Pantheon have shown the ability, and not all of them.

items.text: Adrift in the dark, Dusk first heard the thrumming after eating glowing meat, then more clearly after eating worm paste; a voice he took for Patji's told him he now had the tools he needed.
In a dream, Dusk lived as Cakoban the Navigator, steering a ship through the emberdark while the Current filled its sails.
